name: Emit Defensive Odor
text:
Frequency once per day

---
While athamarus' natural pheromones are typically used for communication, you have developed yours into a defense mechanism to ward off foes. You emit a thick spray of defensive pheromones at an adjacent creature, who takes floor((@actor.level +1/2)+1)d6 poison damage with a basic Fortitude save save against your class DC.

At 3rd level and every 2 levels thereafter, the damage increases by 1d6.
